summary: Comprehensive testing of Pull List feature for resale/consignment business. All 17 backend API tests passed. All 7 frontend UI test scenarios passed. The Pull List correctly displays sold inventory items grouped by SKU row letter with natural sorting.

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor React hydration warning in year selector dropdown

critical_code_review_comments: Backend inventory.py lines 1110-1168: GET /pull-list correctly queries sold items, excludes pulled items when show_pulled=false, applies date filters, and groups by SKU row letter
Backend inventory.py lines 1135-1147: Natural SKU sorting implemented correctly - extracts letters then numbers for proper A6 < A10 ordering
Backend inventory.py lines 1171-1179: POST /mark-pulled correctly updates items with pulled=True and pulled_at timestamp
Backend inventory.py lines 1183-1189: POST /reset correctly unsets pulled and pulled_at fields for undo functionality
Backend inventory.py lines 1192-1212: POST /mark-all-pulled correctly marks all unpulled items in date range
Frontend PullListSection.jsx line 157: Count badge correctly shows unpulled items count
Frontend PullListSection.jsx lines 179-197: Date filter tabs correctly implemented with All Sold, Today, This Week, 2 Weeks options
Frontend PullListSection.jsx lines 259-380: Row grouping and item rendering with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Frontend PullListSection.jsx lines 313-335: Pulled item shows green checkmark that can be clicked to undo (reset)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing ~5000 sold items from Vendoo CSV imports
